basis: Zinc dysregulation/autoinflammation; chronic cytopenias >80% and persistent inflammatory skin lesions >30%. Arthritis omitted at cap; hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver injury.

decisions.haematologic: involved: chronic anemia and neutropenia affect >80% and reflect intrinsic inflammatory marrow/blood dysfunction.
decisions.dermatologic: involved: chronic ulcerative or pyoderma-like inflammatory lesions affect >30%; these represent persistent tissue inflammation.

basis: Heme synthesis defect with defining neurovisceral dysfunction; renal insufficiency 30-79%. Hepatic precursor production alone is not liver injury; visceral symptoms are neurogenic.

decisions.hepatic: none: hepatic precursor synthesis identifies the biochemical source; common intrinsic liver injury is not established.
decisions.neurologic: primary: neurovisceral attacks define AIP; peripheral neuropathy and cranial nerve paralysis are frequent (30-79%).

basis: Inherited amyloid proteopathy; nerve amyloid 4/4, chronic gastrointestinal dysfunction 3/3 and cardiac amyloidosis 1/1. Hepatic deposits lack documented functional injury.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: hereditary B2M amyloidosis is an inherited protein-folding and protein-metabolism disorder.

basis: GPI-anchor biosynthesis disorder with developmental epileptic encephalopathy; hearing impairment 7/14 (50%). Small nails 5/14 do not establish damaging skin/nail disease.

decisions.dermatologic: none: small nails in 5/14 establish a morphological finding, without demonstrated tissue injury or loss of function.

basis: Brain/eye anomalies define syndrome; thyroid hypoplasia/hypothyroidism and sensorineural hearing loss each 30-79%. Renal, vascular and skeletal anomalies omitted at cap.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: congenital thyroid hypoplasia with hypothyroidism occurs in 30-79%; it is a syndromic organ manifestation rather than the defining disease mechanism.

basis: HARP defines lipid abnormality, acanthocytosis, pallidal degeneration and retinitis pigmentosa. Retinal degeneration is a major criterion, placed in involved because primary is capped at three.

decisions.haematologic: primary: acanthocytosis is a defining blood-cell abnormality; the haematologic mechanism axis applies.
decisions.ocular: involved: retinitis pigmentosa is a defining damaging retinal disease; the three-primary cap requires assigning one defining organ to involved.

basis: Developmental disability and congenital limb/skeletal defects define syndrome. Hair morphology and hypoplastic toenails (30-79%) do not establish functional integumentary injury.

decisions.dermatologic: none: frequent hair and nail morphology changes lack evidence of inflammatory, destructive or functionally impairing integumentary disease.

basis: Carotid arterial aneurysm; stroke is a separately diagnosed complication. Cranial nerve paralysis is 5-29%; broader nerve physiology findings do not establish common lasting injury.

decisions.neurologic: none: documented cranial nerve paralysis is 5-29%; nonspecific frequent nerve findings do not establish lasting damage, and stroke is a separate disease.

basis: Congenital ocular motor cranial dysinnervation produces restricted eye movements and secondary extraocular muscle fibrosis; generalized skeletal muscle disease is not established.

decisions.neurologic: primary: CFEOM is a congenital cranial dysinnervation disorder involving ocular motor nerves, with secondary extraocular muscle fibrosis.

basis: Skeletal dysplasia/immunodeficiency; developmental delay/Chiari and asthma each 2/2. Eczema 2/2, cardiac defects and annular pancreas 1/2 omitted at cap; cohort is very small.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: asthma and allergic rhinitis each occur in 2/2 reported patients, supporting persistent inflammatory airway involvement in this syndrome.
decisions.dermatologic: none under cap: eczematoid dermatitis occurs in 2/2, but neurologic abnormalities and inflammatory airway disease take priority.
